reviews.title: Efficient and simple flight.
reviews.text: Flew from Brisbane to Sydney on the final leg home. You get what you pay for with an airline like this. Compared to the other Australian airlines, this is not bad at all. The flight was on time and efficient. They don’t generally have in flight entertainment and most of the food and beverages are an extra charge. Overall, I couldn’t fault the flight.
reviews.author: AndyJohn74

reviews.title: customer service
reviews.text: staff at melbourne airport for virgin are crap! they are so rude and will ignore you on purpose. would never fly with them ever again.
reviews.author: Mhk m

reviews.title: Canceled Again
reviews.text: Virgin Australia used to be a good airline but I would not recommend it now. They seem to cancel flights if not full. Our recent flight Sydney to Hobart was cancelled. It was the last flight to Hobart the excuse given was forecast high winds. Judging by the line up at the “service” desk the plane was only about half full. There were winds, but aircraft were leaving Sydney and others landing in Hobart including other VA flights. The only cancelled flight was ours. All the canceled passengers were forced to find overnight accommodation at the last minute with no compensation from Virgin. Just very poor customer service. Avoid if you possibly can.
reviews.author: Clive W

reviews.title: Last Minute Change of Plane?
reviews.text: Why am I flying out of Cairns rather than Townsville, because Virgin changed the type of aircraft on this route a week before my trip, and they advised we'd be in Economy as there is no Business Class on this type of aircraft! Hence a one-way rental car and a 4 hour drive to Cairns before boarding the substitute flight. Reliability of the flights that I've booked actually happening is about the only complaint that I have with Virgin.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Good Flight
reviews.text: This was the second leg of a Sydney to Townsville flight. Although a different plane to the first leg, the crew were the same, they changed planes with us at Brisbane. A good flight as usual.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Good Airline
reviews.text: This was the first leg of a Sydney to Townsville flight. The plane was great, and the Virgin crew I've always found to be excellent.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Another Virgin debacle
reviews.text: Struggling with Virgin Australia. Currently delayed an hour and no credible information or updates. Blaming catering??? Not good enough Virgin Australia.
reviews.author: GRSR2014wine

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Upgraded to Business Class only to encounter excessive toilet traffic and frequent repulsive toilet stench. Still had toilet stench caked into my nasal passages when I arrived home. Makes me sick recalling it.
reviews.author: Lawrence L

reviews.title: Cancelled seat for no reason
reviews.text: On my recent flight to and from Indonesia I booked seats with extra leg room as I was traveling with my 6’4” son. Several days into the trip I was notified that my seat for the return flight had been cancelled and refunded. No reason given. I was put in a seat with a stranger at the back of the aircraft. The seat next to my son remained empty for the whole flight! I will try to avoid flying Virgin internationally ever again.
reviews.author: Cathy B

reviews.title: Sydney to Sunshine Coast
reviews.text: Flew Sydney to Sunshine Coast on Sunday 28th May at 11.30am. Boarding was delayed but other than that everything else was spot on.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Sunshine Coast to Sydney
reviews.text: Flew Sunshine Coast to Sydney on Tuesday 23rd May at 11.20am. We boarded and already in the sky by departure time, arrived into Sydney as scheduled. Flight was ok for short haul.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Adelaide to Brisbane
reviews.text: Flew Adelaide to Brisbane on Tuesday 9th May at 5.50pm. Boarded early and ready go at 5.45pm which meant we arrived into Brisbane early which is always a good thing. All good with this trip.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Brisbane to Darwin
reviews.text: Flew Brisbane to Darwin on Saturday 29th April. All was good except for meal purchased, it was a toasted sandwich for $12.00, kinda wished I hadn't bought it, wasn't that nice.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Hopeless
reviews.text: I had flights booked with them in 2020, affected by the pandemic. They then conveniently went in to administration, but 'did us all a favour' by giving us travel credits. I went to finally book my flights this year to use them up before they expired, booked my flights accordingly, within a couple of weeks of booking, they changed one of my booked flights to a time that no longer worked for us. Rang their 'customer service' team to ask for a full refund now that they have changed the flight, was told no we would only credit back to travel bank, which expires in December, and they won't extend the expiry date, even though they are the ones changing my confirmed flights. Needless to say, once my flight credits are used up, I won't be going near this airline.
reviews.author: Erica P

reviews.title: Nobody's luggage on aircraft
reviews.text: On a flight from Sydney to Canberra on the 11th June 2023 we were misled by Virgin regarding our luggage. It was a small aircraft that we were made aware of a couple of weeks before we travelled, only to find out after arriving in Canberra that no luggage was on board. I understand the aircraft was small, but Virgin should have been upfront and honest about this and not tell everyone after landing to collect out luggage from the carousel that was never going to arrive. And delayed by about an hour. After waiting several minutes, we were finally told in a disorganised manner that our luggage is in Sydney, and that we need to fill in a form for a courier to deliver it to our home that afternoon. A day later and we are still waiting. Very deceitful by Virgin who knew very well in advance our luggage would not be on the flight. The competition may not be much better but regardless I'll be giving Virgin a miss next time for both personal and work travel.
reviews.author: Brent F

reviews.title: Virgin 6 hour flight delays for domestic travel
reviews.text: Worse airline service ever they will delay your flight multiple times. The customer service phone line is shocking. Was meant to fly at 4 flight got moved to 8.30pm then moved again to 9.30 with more delays worse service ever would not move your flight to a more appropriate time or offer anything else
reviews.author: mary n

reviews.title: Scam fare still no refund
reviews.text: Booked business downgraded to economy, made to pay extra for prem economy. No immediate refund offered and still haven't received the refund or information on the full refund due. No compensation offered for change in cabin class. Seats were too narrow. Fly any other airline except them.
reviews.author: Foodwise

reviews.title: SAMOA here we come
reviews.text: Wow what a surprise carry on luggage not checked by staff.Check in 7kg max .What a joke , the people were carrying more than 1bag on board and they were more than 7 KG.we had to have our carry on under our seats as the storage area was full.The people were careless in every way .It didn't start our holiday in the best way.
reviews.author: Toby P

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Chose to pay extra for Economy X - well worth it. Crew were friendly and courteous. Plane was extremely clean and new. Our in-flight entertainment (via the Entertainment App) wasn't working but a lovely crew member was very helpful and got it to work. We had to circle a few times due to the delays from the fog in Sydney but the Captain kept us informed so that we knew what was going on. Only complimentary tea , coffee and water served which was fine. Food needs to be purchased. My only complaint is the lack of automatic bag drops at Sydney airport - please upgrade!! Even though we checked in online, we still had to wait in a queue to have our bags checked in. Kind of defeats the purpose of online check in.
reviews.author: Karina C

reviews.title: Luggage destroyed
reviews.text: I did transit from Sydney to Cairns. At the end my suitcase came with scratches and one of the wheels plus the attached plastic part all gone. Another nylon bag torn covered by a transparent plastic bag and things came out. There wasn’t any Virgin staff at the baggage claim counter. I had to call almost 10 times to get someone to come. She then gave me the claims number and said SORRY coldly and walked away, It then took me a month to negotiate the baggage claim with lots of documentation required. At the end they didn’t even want to compensate and asked me to get them repaired and told them the cost. I were furious and rejected and finally they just willing to compensate 1/4 the cost of the loss. Shame on Virgin!
reviews.author: ghostmark

reviews.title: VIRGIN AIRLINE IS SO BAD
reviews.text: OH my goodness in melbourne virgin airline checkin , They had 2 seats double booked so they made their passengers move seats CAN U BELIEVE IT? And we couldnt check in at Sydney because their luggage wasnt REGISTERED UNDER THE RIGHT NAME. And they didnt print the luggage number AND weight. SO THEY GAVE THEIR passengers EXTRA WORK. Their service is so trash
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Never again, their airport staff in Melbourne were rude. For a international flight their service was useless
reviews.author: Paris B

reviews.title: 2 delays
reviews.text: 2 delay flights at the same trip. One delay to go to Melbourne, some issue that made us wait for 2 hours and another to go Back to Gold Coast, more 2 hours waiting ..
reviews.author: Mariana M

reviews.title: Virgin business not worth it - they need to do a lot better
reviews.text: Let's start with the issue that virgin has NO international lounges. Then there is the food, it was either chicken or vego (make that vego by the time they got to me). Frankly, I don't know why they bother, it's hard to describe how ordinary it was. Luckily for me the flight attendant agreed to my suggestion that an economy chicken sandwich would be infinitely better and grabbed me one. Lastly, on a positive, they have great staff who do try their best to give you a good experience with the poor tools they have.
reviews.author: Jbs

reviews.title: No Business Class Lounge or Partner Lounge in Denpasar. Appalling. Exorbitant fares. The proper rating is 0
reviews.text: This was the worst 'Business Class' flight I have ever experienced. It was less than an economy flight. On boarding, my seat was occupied and I was moved to another seat occupied by a baby. I believe the two young mothers with babies in these seats were probably 'influencers'. The aircraft is in huge need of maintenance. The return flight was even worse, if this is possible. It was so cold - no blankets provided. Very uncomfortable seat with a minimal recline. Impossible to rest, let alone sleep. Virgin should not be offering a business class service when there are no comparable business class facilities provided.
reviews.author: Maureen M

reviews.title: Not wonderful - the service to long term flyers is awful
reviews.text: I fly a lot. Lately the service on Virgin has gone down and their care factor for frequent flyers is zero. Planes are often poorly cleaned, they are always cramped, the inflight entertainment more often does not work, there is no internet connectivity. On a flight to Perth of 4 hours, sandiches ran out after row 4, food in economy is full of stog and the poor cabin crew are left to apologies for the poor company rules and regulations. I was a Platinum FF for 10 years and recently was relegated to Gold despite flying 50 sectors (missed the cut off by 100 status points) and the distain show to Gold FF is palpable. Grow Up Virgin and learn to look after your customers. Try and Fly Forward? Don't bother asking - so rather than being on a flight 4 hours earleir, I find myself sitting in their subpar lounge writing about how angry I am at them wasting my time. Tip for old players...... FLY QANTAS
reviews.author: Felicity Y

reviews.title: Upgrade me premium bid is a scam - avoid like the plague
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs - virgin's upgrade me bid system is a total scam Whatever you do, don't be fooled. When my wife and I received the upgrade me bid email we were curious. We put in offers that were deemed "very poor" for both our outbound and inbound flights - yet both were accepted. The first was an eye watering $740 for our perth to melbourne leg. When we allocated separate seats in different rows, we phoned customer service, who informed us that if we simply request to be downgraded back to economy at the airport, we will be refunded the upgrade fare. We were downgraded to economy at the airport and submitted a refund request. We also noted that business class was full on our flight. We then tried to cancel the upgrade bid for the return flight to ensure we didn't go through this drama again, but the website wouldnt let us cancel. We phoned customer service , who said there was no outstanding upgrade bid for our return flight. A day later, we were upgraded again. This time, for a slightly less eye watering $490. However having seen the "business class" seats on our first flight - a continuation of economy, separated by a rope and with no real point of difference from economy, we wouldn't pay $50 more for these seats. We phoned customer service again, who told us to repeat the same process at the airport and request a refund after flying economy then submit a refund request after. Because our tickets would show economy, virgin wouldn't charge us the upgrade fare, so they said. We have since been charged for both flights - a total of $1,230 - despite flying economy both ways and with business class full on both flights. We will never fly virgin again and express the strongest caution for anyone entertaining the scam that is Virgin's Upgrademebid
reviews.author: Ian

reviews.title: We were impressed
reviews.text: During a recent domestic Australian trip, we had the difficult decision whether to fly Qantas or Virgin Australia. We didn’t know anything about either. After researching which was the better option for us, we decided to take a risk and fly Virgin Australia due to a cheaper price and better outgoing time than Qantas, even though Qantas had the better reviews. We were impressed by the professionalism of the staff and cleanliness of the airplane. The seats were standard and something you would see on a United or American Airlines flight. The snack was edible and the bathrooms were in good condition. The main disappointment was the pricing for the flight which I believe was quite high for the time and distance.
reviews.author: Quest684210

reviews.title: Crap customer service, smashed my case
reviews.text: I live in the UK and travelled to Australia, during my stay I travelled with Virgin Australia from Sydney to Noosa, on collecting my case it had been smashed and one of four wheels was snapped off and case was split down the side. Immediately went to Virgin desk ( no apology) just indifferent staff that gave me a form to complete, and told it would take time. I had had 6 more flights during our holiday and this case could not be used. I had no choice but to purchase a new case ( not the cheapest, but not dearest either). I have been home now to 2 weeks and my claim is still not sorted. Numerous , emails, calls, resending documents/photos that they claim they have not received. Every time you email, I receive a new reference number and the whole process doesn’t appear to have and end. The communication from Virgin Australia is shocking and almost non existent. They have called but get cut off within few minutes, never call again, so nothing gets sorted. Crap crap crap, avoid them at all costs. I shouldn’t have to claim on my holiday insurance and lose money paying excess, when they are responsible, as the only option. I even complained to complaints team, only to be ignored
reviews.author: tracie G

reviews.title: Mr Mark Tryon
reviews.text: We have never been on a international flight that has zero service. No entertainment, no food service even though when we googled It, it said they did. Nothing short of a tin can with wings. And the ticket price is very high for the tiny domestic jet they used. When booking it stated 5.5 hours. It was 6.5 and a half hour late for no apparent reason. We will never fly Virgin again.
reviews.author: travel3145

reviews.title: Crappiest service ever from an airline
reviews.text: The flights from ASP to CNS with transition in Brisbane got delayed several times. In total from 1.25 pm to 9 pm. So I got stuck in Brisbane at 1 am in the morning. Meal voucher only to be used at Brisbane, which did not happen at 1 am, of course, No chance of rebooking to other flights, zero service. Obviously not willing to handle a refund. Flight personnel mentioned that this happened the 4th time now during the last weeks. Never ever will I book this airline again. Problems can occur, but not offering solutions or service in unacceptable.
reviews.author: travelpro

reviews.title: International “business class” is almost false advertising
reviews.text: Paid AUD $1500 one way to finish up a fabulous Bali holiday No lounge access at Bali airport (even JQ gives you this) And as there are no actual airline lounges at Ngurah Rai there is no reciprocal access for virgin lounge membership or velocity status So add another $60 to your ticket if you want to sit in the lounge… Flight delayed by 2 hours with not a single announcement from Virgin, the flight was still showing as “on time” until 2 hours after the scheduled departure time Airport staff just shrugged their shoulders when asked if there was any update, flight departures board didn’t indicate any delays Even the crew turned up at the gate and had no idea the flight was running late…one of the FAs said sarcastically “what a surprise”… Once boarded… Had to brush crumbs of the seat and the floors hadn’t been vacuumed No blankets, pillows or amenities (despite the website showing these clearly in photos in the international business class section)…cabin crew mentioned vaguely something about them being removed during COVID… The cabin was freezing and passengers all around me were reaching for jackets and fiddling with the air vents I asked for my dinner to be served later in the flight which the FA said would be no problem, just give them 30 minutes notice to heat it up… When I did ask for my meal the FA told me it “had gone cold”…because it had already been heated up…for some reason She did give me a crew chicken sandwich…which was stale (I’m not making this up) No snacks offered with drinks, had to ask for them And lastly STILL nowhere to hang or put your device inflight or during meals, people were balancing them under meal trays How much effort would it be to sew a leather strip into the back of the 8 J seats… Have flown in the new Max recently and no sign of the promised new business class seats… This cannot be called international business class by any stretch of the imagination Never thought I’d say it but Jetstar Business and even ScootBiz come out miles ahead of Virgins overpriced and underwhelming offering on this route I’ll continue to chase status credits but I’ll be paying another airline to accrue them A budget carrier charging legacy fares Don’t waste your hard earned cash
reviews.author: Budd Haeye

reviews.title: Flight cancellations twice
reviews.text: Virgin have twice cancelled my flights. Replacement flight are indirect connecting flights instead of initial direct that now take 7-8 hours instead of initial 4 direct. Connecting flights on past flights dont work out and have had too many problems there. 'Sorry' is communicated like a flimsy band aid. I am a velocity member and really unimpressed.
reviews.author: Sally H

reviews.title: Terrible customer service at the check in counter and lounge
reviews.text: My wife and I flew Virgin Australia for the very FIRST time today, 21 April 2023 from Sydney to Melbourne. And boy, we were very disappointed with the service at the checkin counter in Sydney and from Lisa at the VA lounge in Sydney. We are both premier elite members with United Airlines and we were advised that because VA and United are partners, whatever privileges we enjoy with United will also be honored at VA (example: checked in luggage up to 70 lbs, no weighing of hand carry, etc). But the two middle aged ladies at the Sydney airport refused to honor our united Airlines privileges as elite member (1K). They made us re-arrange our hand carry so the weight will be 8kg. We were unpacking and moving our stuff at the airport. Terrible feeling!! We were never treated this way. Then my wife’s checked in Iuggage was slightly over weight and again these two ladies wanted us to repack or pay $50.00. Why? We were within the allowed weight limit based on our status with your partner airlines. To finish our check in process, we just paid $50 this is wrong and we should have not paid. Regarding the lady at the VA lounge, she was rude and condescending. Not acceptable. I hope someone counsels her. I will not fly this airline again. Have never felt this bad
reviews.author: Cheryl a

reviews.title: Rude & harassment staff
reviews.text: I travelled from Nadi to Sydney on 22/4 was on premium economy seat. Approached by a female staff member to swap seat with 15 year old as they booked exit seat. I explained there is a reason I purchased this particular seat. The staff member was adamant I should move as (I was a solo traveler) from my seat to exit door seat to accommodate the other family. I bluntly refused to do so as I paid for my seat. Staff member rudely said, ‘so you won’t move from your seat’, my reply ‘No’. Her response was, ‘ than I will need to forcefully move someone out of their seat to accommodate this family. My reply to the staff member was ‘ why would you forcefully move a passenger from their paid seat’, staff replied, ‘because I can do that’. I remained seated in my seat and waited for the forceful removal. Can Virgin airline provide such policy on passengers forcefully removed from their paid seat to accommodate the 15 year old a window seat. Was it my fault that this particular family travelling with a 15 year old & virgin airline blunder. Wasn’t it checked during booking times? Couldn’t an adult (father/mother) sit near the exit door? I am 4 months post op surgery, I wouldn’t be much help open the exit door in case of emergency and I am not allowed to push or pull heavy object. I was in tears afterwards and hated to be in this flight. I found virgin staff rude and racist towards me as I probably was the only person with dark skin and the rest was Caucasians. The flight was horrible, no entertainment or food for one way expensive ticket. I did not realised all this exclusions until I was on board. It took staff , 3 hours to get me another custom form. I have travelled many airlines but to date I found Virgin Airlines staff horrible rude and racist. If this airline is for Caucasians, please paste it all over as I ain’t booking this airline at all. Will cancel my Velocity membership as well. I. N Seat 3F - VA184
reviews.author: I N

reviews.title: Forget these fools
reviews.text: Missed a friends funeral. My flight was at 8, they informed me at 5 that my flight was delayed a whole day. This is not he first time they have caused me to miss a major life event. I missed my best mates wedding ceremony when they did the exact same thing. They are a budget airline charging like a premium service. They cannot keep planes in the air and their customer service is the worst I have ever come across. When I left a complaint about missing my friends wedding, I did not even get a reply. While ol mate is tossing around in space like he’s the saviour of humanity, virgin is falling apart. DO NOT FLY WITH VIRGIN
reviews.author: adjpalmer

reviews.title: Same old, but good
reviews.text: Virgin Australia gives you that feeling that you know what you are getting into as the planes are almost all the same layout and that gives you a comfortable feeling. Staff is great and friendly, seats are comfortable and flights go by fast. Nothing different about this trip. Great from check in to baggage claim.
reviews.author: Wala69

reviews.title: Service has declined as prices rise
reviews.text: Flight was delayed in pushback even though passengers had been on board for 20 minutes. Only boarded through front door so boarding took forever. Late in to Melbourne and then made passengers wait on board aircraft while crew who were travelling as passengers were let off plane first since they were running late for their next service. Tough for any passengers with connecting flights. Luggage from 3 flights dropped on one baggage carousel while other 2 were empty. Had priority baggage with one bag arriving 20 minutes before the other. Care factor from staff is low. Quality of service is poor. Ability to give truthful reasons for delays is non-existant.
reviews.author: Robert M

reviews.title: Brisbane to Cairns return business class
reviews.text: We always use Virgin as preferred frequent airline for our points gathering. Always on time domestically within Australia and never had issue with delays or cancelled flights like the other two main domestic airlines. Staff always professional and courteous. This time we moved from normal economy x to business class each way.Loved it totally.We tend to fly mornings and don't get the full benefit of the Virgin Lounges to use to the maximum. Think from now we will just accumulate points and do returns via business.Food on flight up and down was the green curry-excellent meal.On the way back from Cairns we were looked after by Lauren.Fantastic service, thank you Lauren.
reviews.author: stuart c

reviews.title: Business Class to Bali is terrible
reviews.text: Would not waste your money, No pillow, no blanket, no foot rest. This is red eye flight and I thought this would be at least comfortable. This is a new flight operating and I think Virgin has dropped the ball with their service for everyone on that flight. the main cabin has only 2 toilets for everyone and not even a snack. the food in business was so average with soggy Crockers and dried hard cheese with a stale carrot cake that was yuk. It was expensive and I wish I did not hate my money. This plane is way too small for over 5 hours. No business lounge in Bali either. the main cabin has only 2 toilets for the entire flight besides the 8 in business. No food unless you pay and the menu is just awful when you need to eat dinner.
reviews.author: Nikki

reviews.title: All on-time and pleasant experience.
reviews.text: From arrival at check-in with baggage, the whole process was problem free. On time departure and arrival both ways and a pleasant crew.
reviews.author: Colin B

reviews.title: Business Club is pathetic
reviews.text: My wife and I travelled to Bali fo our wedding anniversary. We paid for a Businees Club return flights what a joke there are no business lounges either in Melbourne or Bali, the wine on board is nearly undrinkable! Do not provide any inflight equipment to view the entertainment. Will not fly Virgin again!
reviews.author: Rusty M

reviews.title: Flight cancelled while sitting on plane
reviews.text: How can an airline stuff up your plans moreso than cancelling your flight beforehand? They delay your flight, then tell you to board the plane & put your seatbelts on, and THEN have the captain tell you over the speaker that the flight is cancelled and to disembark the plane. Not cool Virgin Australia.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY WITH VIRGIN
reviews.text: Flight was Sydney to Melb 4pm flight. Flight was delayed 2hrs. During the flight we almost got to Melbourne before the announcement "we are going back to Sydney". No explanation from the pilot and all the cabin crew told us was that Melbourne couldnt fuel the plane...which made no sense!! We got back to Sydney about 9pm and the cabin crew told us if we werent Sydney residents to book accommodation (as there were no other flights available that night) and that Virgin would reimburse us for accommodation, transfers and food. Difficult to organise last minute at this time of night and cost a fortune. Didn't get back to Melbourne until 12pm the next day which added other stresses. I kept all of my receipts and made a compensation claim that day. The next day I got a response saying that the compensation would not be granted as the cancellation was due to weather WHICH WAS A COMPLETE LIE! When I called up, I was greeted twice by rude customer service representatives who did not help at all. The most disgusting service ever!! I recorded the entire ordeal on the plane and the blatant lies they told us. I will not stop until everyone knows how unprofessional they are.
reviews.author: sel s

reviews.title: very rude staff
reviews.text: staff were not welcoming. did not say or help us with anything when we needed it. were looking at us very rudely and did not smile or say anything. they proceeded to help other customers struggling but when they saw teenagers they decided they were not capable of helping or directing us. very unfriendly and made us feel extremely disappointed. usually flight attendants from other airlines smile and talk and help with us. but not virgin australia. every attendant we passed did not welcome us and were unfriendly. i will be unlikely to be flying with virgin again in the future as i felt unwelcome and uncomfortable around these flight attendants.
reviews.author: Kleo

reviews.title: Shocking airline
reviews.text: My father and I booked 3 internal flights using Virgin Australia. We are from the UK and it was always my father's dream to travel to Australia (he is 77) so I booked a bit of a father and son 4 city trip to Australia. The first internal flight Perth to Melbourne was delayed by an hour which was standard. The third flight Gold coast to Sydney was delayed by nearly 4 hours which was annoying wasted a good chunk of a day in Sydney. However the topping on the cake was the second transfer from Melbourne to gold coast. On arriving at the airport to check in at 8am for a 11am flight was told my booking was gone, I had checked the night before and it was still there all fine! We were informed we had been moved to the 7pm flight instead with virtually no warning The flight had not been cancelled and left at a reasonable time , we had unfortunately been the victim of overbooking and our seats sold to someone else. Customer service was very dismissive and not interested in assisting so the 2 of us had to loiter around Melbourne Airport for an extra 8hrs . Our car hire at the gold coast was closed on arrival so we incurred extra taxi costs from and to the airport plus the wasted car hire and the loss of a full day at the gold coast. VA have declined any compensation even though the cost of the 7pm flight was about half of the premium timed 11am flight (that's all I was hoping to get). I know overbooking happens and is standard airline practice and I am a regular flyer around the world and fortunately this has never happened to me before but to not receive anything in compensation for losing our seats through no fault of ours and no help in vouchers at the airport for our lengthy delay bearing in mind my father is 77 !!!! Shame on you Virgin Australia. Passenger treatment is much better in Europe for delays and cancellations .....
reviews.author: Michael R

reviews.title: THE WORST EVERYTHING
reviews.text: Where to start - My Business Class Virgin experience from Bali to Melb ...the priority check in line took longer than my friend in the economy line. My seat whilst of a larger size reclined about 10 degrees & no foot rest. There is absolutely no entertainment unless you have your own device & headphones. With only 8 people in business class I was advised my meal choice was unavailable, as was the passenger across from me. We were left with the vegetarian pasta that tasted of plain noodles with no flavour. There are No Blankets. Our immigration document was sitting on our seat armrest as we boarded so as that was one less thing they had to do. Staff talked loudly in the galley & another passenger had his water spilt over the tray as his meal was being delivered - not due to turbulence. I am still perplexed as to what you get for this significant extra financial purchase !! Do not waste your money - absolutely rock bottom service & what appeared to be inexperienced, uninterested staff.
reviews.author: Nicki H

reviews.title: Horrible airline
reviews.text: Booked flights for the family (2 adults + 3 kids, 7-12 yrs) on Virgin's website on the day of departure. Booking and check in went well. The flight was almost 2 hours delayed due to technical issues - got very limited information and no excuse. Here is room for improvement. Before boarding, we were assigned new seats and given 4 new boarding passes - one too few. Pointed out the mistake. We were now given 7 boarding cards - 2 too many! The seats were spread over several rows from 8 to 15. After exchanging seats with other passengers, we gathered the family in one row - as before. The other passengers were also confused about the re-allocation of seats. The whole thing made no sense. The plane, a Boeing 737-700, was very old. It was therefore not surprising that technical problems arose. The interior was yellowed and worn. The seats were old and on several of them the seat backs could not be folded down or raised without help from the cabin crew or use of force. The headrest on my seat could not stay in position and slid down onto the back every few minutes - very uncomfortable and annoying. Virgin Australia seems to have no control - and is an airline far below modern standards.
reviews.author: Cosmo

reviews.title: Give Vergin a wide/wide berth
reviews.text: I can see by the previous comments that Virgin are getting a rubbish name and with my experience they deserve it. Economy from Brisbane... no indication prior to flight that there were no meals or drinks served but could be bought in flight which were crisps cheese and biscuits like the rubbish kid throw out of their lunch box's. A small bottle of undrinkable wine for $12. No entertainment screen, had to use your lap top or phone. Oh tea, coffee or a glass of water were offered for FREE. Return to Brisbane business. ( This is the best part ) Arrived at the airport early because of early hotel departure thinking that the business lounge would be available. Wrong again Virgin have no early booking and you have to wait until the booking desks open 3 hours before take off. At last the desks open and are informed that Virgin have no business lounge at the airport, although many other airlines are catered for. At last on the plane. Business seats only recline about 10 degrees and have no leg rests. A tasteless meal was served with an undrinkable glass of wine. And to top it all off there are no blankets supplied for the night flight home. If you have to use them bring warm clothing as the cabin is cold. Never again will I travel with Virgin you would get better conditions on a Greyhound Coach. Virgin reminds me of when I flew within the US. " Sit down shut up and we will tell you when to get off" With regards to the cabin staff they were courteous to us but they have to follow orders.
reviews.author: trebor95

reviews.title: Happy with service
reviews.text: Have actually had a really good experience on the first leg of our flight, so much better customer service and flights than jetstar who we have flown with in the past (family of 5). We had to change flight times due to kids having exam date changes, customer service were fabulous and put us on a later flight for no extra charge despite us only having lite fares. We didn’t book seats, but they placed us all together (we have teens who are gigantic, not kids) which was a bonus. Flight itself was seamless, plenty of leg room, lots of cabin baggage locker space, on time, baggage out early, no complaints, hopefully return flight goes just as smoothly!
reviews.author: HeatherBish
